t: Jekyll Lunr.JS Static Site Search (aka GitHub Pages Search)
s: This article details implementing client-side search for Jekyll sites using Lunr.js by generating a `search.json` index. It emphasizes the human-in-the-middle approach to AI-assisted content generation and keyword extraction, highlighting the challenges and benefits of using LLMs like Gemini, DeepSeek, and ChatGPT for this process.
sub: AI-assisted content keyword generation and extraction
Managing AI quotas and switching models
Maintaining flow state during repetitive technical tasks
